videos.author: THE AD FACTORY
videos.summary: Google's "Dear Sophie" Chrome ad, in which a father emails his daughter's life moments to her future self over the years. It portrays an email account as a lifelong keepsake.
videos.why: Brought up ironically in threads about Google deleting inactive accounts and tightening storage policies, as a reminder that Google once encouraged this kind of long-term use.

videos.title: Adam Savage's Spot Robot Rickshaw Carriage!
videos.author: Adam Savage’s Tested
videos.summary: Adam Savage builds a Victorian-style rickshaw carriage for Boston Dynamics' Spot robot to pull, with him riding as passenger. The video covers the build and the engineering problems of pairing cutting-edge robotics with vintage transport, such as tuning the payload through Spot's API.
videos.why: HN commenters cite it as a fun real-world example of Spot hauling a passenger whenever Boston Dynamics robots come up.
